summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by STRATS Trust for Dominion Resources, Inc. Securities, Series 2005-6, an asset-backed trust, reporting a routine scheduled distribution to certificate holders on April 15, 2026. It contains no special-situation event: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing merely states the distribution occurred and references publicly available reports of the issuer, Dominion Resources. No deal terms or special event are involved.
